title.zh: 黄仁勋划定AI安全红线：客户开发不安全软件，英伟达可能停止供芯片
title.en: 黄仁勋划定AI安全红线：客户开发不安全软件，英伟达可能停止供芯片

current_state.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company could in principle stop supplying chips to customers developing unsafe AI software, while Nvidia pledged $250 million in computing resources over five years to UK AI safety research focused on agent safety testing.
current_state.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company could in principle stop supplying chips to customers developing unsafe AI software, while Nvidia pledged $250 million in computing resources over five years to UK AI safety research focused on agent safety testing.
